QuestInfo.name: [Temple of Time] Seeking Lost Memories
QuestInfo.0: According to the Memory Keeper, you must return to where your adventure began to recover lost memories. Your adventures... yes, they began when you joined the Xuanshan School, and met with the master and your brothers and sisters. Talk with Xiao Xiao.
QuestInfo.2:
Your heart was warmed by simply talking about the times you and Xiao Xiao trained under the master. 
You realized that your adventure started both when you became a student of the Xuanshan School and #ewhen you ventured away from it, stepping into a new world#k. Even in your deepest moments of despair, you always held the hope of one day rebuilding the Xuanshan School. You should never let go of that goal.
